in_hebrew.name: גברט
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Gibert is derived from the Hebrew word 'gabar' which means 'to be strong, brave, or a warrior. This name would have been given to a child who was expected to exhibit these qualities and to grow up to be a strong and courageous individual.

in_greek.name: Γιβερτ
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Gibert is derived from the Greek word 'gibberos' which means 'powerful, strong, or a warrior. This name was given to a child who was expected to display strength and bravery, and to grow up to be a formidable and valiant individual.

in_latin.name: Gibertus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Gibertus is derived from the Latin word 'gibber' which means 'to laugh' or 'to bubble'. However, it is also believed to be derived from the Latin word 'gibberus' which means 'hasty, quick, or nimble'. The name may have been given to a child who was expected to be quick-witted, agile, or to have a good sense of humor.
